contract_metadata.governing_document: Phase 1 Engineering Identity & Physics Contract Correction

taxonomy_definitions.IMPLEMENTED: Executable functionality exists in the repository codebase.
taxonomy_definitions.PARTIALLY_IMPLEMENTED: A simplified, reduced-order, lumped-parameter, or proxy model exists in executable code, but key physical sub-phenomena are omitted.
taxonomy_definitions.NOT_IMPLEMENTED: No executable equations, mathematical representations, or physical states exist in the codebase.

subsystem_a_environment.name: Environment & Atmosphere
implemented_features: International Standard Atmosphere (ISA) pressure calculation as a function of altitude
ISA ambient temperature calculation with standard tropospheric lapse rate (0.0065 K/m)
Air density computation via ideal gas law (rho = P / (R * T))
Density ratio (sigma = rho / rho0) calculation
missing_or_unmodeled_features: Non-ISA temperature offsets (ISA +/- delta T)
Humidity and moisture vapor pressure effects on intake density
Dynamic ram-air recovery pressure as a function of flight Mach/airspeed
Turbulence and gust wind velocity vectors

subsystem_b_intake_boost.name: Intake & Turbocharger Boost
missing_or_unmodeled_features: Exhaust gas turbocharger thermodynamic equations
Centrifugal compressor pressure ratio and efficiency maps
Radial turbine mass flow expansion and enthalpy extraction
Electronic Turbo Control Unit (TCU) closed-loop wastegate servo positioning
Wastegate bypass valve mass flow dynamics
Airbox manifold absolute pressure (MAP) state variable
Charge-air compression heating and airbox temperature dynamics
Critical altitude boost-control threshold (~4572 m / 15,000 ft)
subsystem_b_intake_boost.current_simplification_note: Current simulator uses naturally aspirated density derating (power proportional to ambient density ratio sigma). No turbocharger or boost physics exist in code.

subsystem_c_combustion.name: Combustion & Fuel Consumption
implemented_features: Willans-line affine fuel mass flow approximation as a function of mechanical power
Lumped fuel lower heating value (LHV = 43.5 MJ/kg) energy conversion
Parametric combustion power loss multipliers for simulated lean and rich fault conditions
missing_or_unmodeled_features: Chemical equilibrium / air-fuel equivalence ratio (lambda / phi) computation
In-cylinder pressure-volume (P-V) thermodynamic cycle (Otto cycle)
Spark ignition timing and spark-advance curves
Individual carburetor (Bing 64) jet metering and float bowl dynamics
Dual electric fuel pump pressure delivery and return line hydraulic loop
Combustion incomplete burn / knock / detonation phenomena
evidence_references: simulator/config.py: TierCParameters Willans slope and idle intercept

subsystem_d_crankshaft_dynamics.name: Crankshaft Rotational Dynamics
implemented_features: 1-DOF rotational equation of motion: J * (d_omega/dt) = T_comb - T_fric - T_load
Viscous friction torque linear with rotational speed (k_fric_linear)
Coulomb / pumping static friction torque (torque_fric_static)
Forward Euler numerical ODE integration with configurable time step (default dt = 0.1 s)
Idle governor closed-loop RPM stabilization at 1400 RPM
missing_or_unmodeled_features: Torsional crankshaft elasticity and cyclic angular velocity variations per firing event
Multi-mass rotating assembly (crank, counterweights, connecting rods, pistons)
High-order numerical integrator (e.g. RK4) with adaptive step size

subsystem_e_gearbox_propeller.name: Reduction Gearbox & Propeller Drivetrain
missing_or_unmodeled_features: Rotax 914 UL/F integrated spur reduction gearbox with 2.4286:1 (51:21) reduction ratio
Propeller-side rotational speed telemetry (prop_rpm = engine_rpm / 2.4286)
Torsional dog-clutch vibration damper dynamics and backlash
Gear mesh mechanical transmission efficiency and heat generation
Variable-pitch / constant-speed propeller governor aerodynamics and blade pitch angle
subsystem_e_gearbox_propeller.current_simplification_note: Current simulator integrates crankshaft directly against a lumped inertia (J=0.28 kg*m^2) with 1:1 direct propeller load torque (T_load = k_load * omega^2). Gearbox reduction is omitted.

subsystem_f_thermal_system.name: Thermal System (CHT & EGT)
implemented_features: Lumped 1-node thermal capacitance ODE for Cylinder Head Temperature (CHT)
Convective cooling conductance scaling with engine RPM and flight airspeed proxy
Empirical algebraic Exhaust Gas Temperature (EGT) formulation with load and density dependencies
First-order dynamic thermocouple lag filter (tau = 2.5 s) for EGT telemetry
missing_or_unmodeled_features: 4 individual cylinder head thermal nodes (CHT cyl 1..4)
4 individual exhaust runner thermocouples (EGT cyl 1..4)
Liquid cooling closed circuit: water pump impeller flow, coolant radiator, expansion tank, thermostat valve
Distinction between ram-air cooled cylinder barrels and liquid-cooled cylinder heads
Waterless vs water/glycol coolant phase change or boiling dynamics
evidence_references: simulator/engine_simulator.py: _step_thermal() CHT ODE and EGT filter

subsystem_g_lubrication.name: Lubrication System (Oil Temp & Pressure)
implemented_features: Lumped 1-node thermal capacitance ODE for engine oil temperature
Thermal conduction coupling between cylinder head (CHT) and oil circuit
Oil cooler convective heat rejection
Algebraic oil pressure model with linear RPM pump gain and empirical temperature-viscosity proxy drop
missing_or_unmodeled_features: Dry sump hydraulic circuit: camshaft-driven trochoid pump, crankcase scavenge, external oil tank
Oil pressure relief / bypass valve opening dynamics
True viscosity-temperature curve (e.g. SAE 10W-40 / ASTM D341 Walther equation)
Oil filter differential pressure and bypass mode
Oil foaming, aeration, or oil consumption rate
evidence_references: simulator/engine_simulator.py: _step_lubrication() oil thermal ODE and pressure equation
simulator/config.py: TierCParameters c_oil, q_oil_fraction, h_oil_cool, k_oil_p_temp

subsystem_h_vibration.name: Vibration Dynamics
implemented_features: Analytical synthesis of 1x (fundamental crankshaft rotational speed) harmonic amplitude
Analytical synthesis of 2x (half-engine order / second harmonic) harmonic amplitude
Vibration amplitude scaling with engine mechanical load
Broadband Gaussian process noise addition (std = 0.06 g)
Mechanical degradation fault scaling on 1x/2x harmonics and noise variance
missing_or_unmodeled_features: Multi-axis (tri-axial X/Y/Z) physical casing acceleration kinematics
Structural transmission paths, mount compliance, and airframe modal resonances
High-frequency combustion pressure knock vibrations (>5 kHz)
Gear mesh vibration frequencies (propeller reduction gear tooth-passing frequency)

subsystem_i_electrical.name: Electrical & Ignition System
missing_or_unmodeled_features: Dual capacitive discharge ignition (CDI) circuits with dual spark plugs per cylinder (8 total)
Internal 250 W Ducati / Denso AC generator with external rectifier-regulator
Optional external 40 A alternator with mechanical belt drive and engine parasitic load torque
12 V aircraft lead-acid / lithium battery state of charge (SoC) dynamics
TCU power supply bus voltage monitoring and low-voltage shutdown protection
subsystem_i_electrical.current_simplification_note: No electrical, ignition, or generator equations exist in the simulator.

subsystem_multi_cylinder.name: Multi-Cylinder Thermodynamics & Mechanics
missing_or_unmodeled_features: 4 individual thermodynamic cylinder control volumes with 1-4-3-2 firing sequence
Per-cylinder compression ratio variations and ring wear degradation
Per-cylinder fuel/air delivery distribution disparity between carburetors
Per-cylinder CHT sensors (CHT_1, CHT_2, CHT_3, CHT_4)
Per-cylinder EGT thermocouples (EGT_1, EGT_2, EGT_3, EGT_4)
subsystem_multi_cylinder.current_simplification_note: Current simulator is a 0D single-node lumped model. All multi-cylinder spatial distribution is unmodeled.
evidence_references: simulator/engine_simulator.py: scalar cht and egt states

phase_2_contracts.phase_title: Phase 2: Turbocharged Intake, Drivetrain & Multi-Cylinder Physics

implemented_features: Physically coupled exhaust conditions -> turbine work -> compressor work loop
Centrifugal compressor pressure ratio and isentropic heating ODE
TCU closed-loop rate-limited wastegate servo actuator
Downstream intake manifold pressure lag dynamics with throttle restriction
Altitude saturation ceiling at continuous critical altitude (4572 m)
subsystem_b_intake_boost.surrogate_disclosure: Exhaust manifold pressure, turbine expansion, and pressure ratio are modeled quantities (MODEL_ASSUMPTION / MODEL_CALIBRATION) rather than OEM compressor/turbine maps.

implemented_features: Integrated spur reduction gearbox with 2.4286:1 (51:21) ratio
Propeller speed telemetry: omega_prop = omega_eng / 2.4286
Propeller aerodynamic torque load reflection with gearbox efficiency
Strict mechanical power conservation: P_eng_out >= P_prop
4 discrete cylinders with 1-4-3-2 firing sequence
Deterministic geometric/airflow bank variations
Per-cylinder CHT (cht_cyl1..4) and EGT (egt_cyl1..4) states
Local cylinder-state independence with shared-system coupling (crankshaft, exhaust enthalpy, cooling loop)
Documented arithmetic mean aggregations for backward compatibility
Effective lumped liquid coolant loop thermal mass (C_coolant = 4500 J/K, MODEL_CALIBRATION)
Heat transfer from 4 cylinder heads into liquid loop
Thermostat regulation opening above 80 deg C
Radiator forced convection cooling scaling with airspeed
